clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Skin of Sweet Rum is bound for Lakeshire, where war has thinned the tavern's stores.

Lakeshire's tavern supplies are running low as the Blackrock orc invasion cuts off the roads into the Redridge Mountains. Barkeep Daniels needs drink for the town guards and refugees, so he sends travelers to gather regional specialties. Among them is a waterskin of sweet rum from the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
